description: mark/unmark a habit for any day; prevent duplicate same-day check-ins
spec:
1. Implement POST /api/v1/habits/:id/checkins with a date to mark a day done.
2. Implement DELETE /api/v1/habits/:id/checkins/:date to unmark a day.
3. Enforce the unique (habitId, date) constraint so duplicate same-day check-ins are impossible.
4. Return the created check-in on mark and 204 on unmark.
5. Attempting to mark an already-marked day returns a conflict, not a duplicate row.
6. Implement GET /api/v1/habits/:id/checkins to list a habit's check-ins.
7. Confirm unmarking a non-existent check-in is a safe no-op or 404.
title: Check-in toggle tracking
